method: Primary-source web retrieval. Source mechanisms do not prove Aeliqo implementation or performance. Recheck volatile APIs at M0 and release.

sources.title: A2UI catalogs
sources.designImplication: Catalog-constrained declarative UI is existing prior art. Aeliqo must prove additional semantics, query and task-preserving interaction value rather than claiming all agent UI is new.

sources.title: json-render documentation
sources.designImplication: Schema/catalog-driven generated UI exists. Aeliqo owns complete components and the governed data-to-experience boundary; do not claim zero competitors.

sources.title: Tambo generative components
sources.designImplication: Registered generative components and interactable application surfaces are prior art; compare equivalent tasks rather than feature names.

sources.title: Vega-Lite composition
sources.designImplication: Layer/facet/concat/repeat are established compositional mechanisms. Combined domains still need semantic checks.

sources.title: Vega-Lite parameters
sources.designImplication: Selections, filter transforms and scale-domain changes are distinct; Aeliqo should not conflate view extent with query population.

sources.title: Draco constraints API
sources.designImplication: Hard/soft constraints support validation and ranking, but do not prove a universal best UX or empirically optimal Aeliqo scores.

sources.title: Substrait specification
sources.designImplication: Engine-independent compute plans are prior art. Use a small Aeliqo logical subset without importing an entire federation engine into the browser.

sources.title: OpenAPI specification
sources.designImplication: API descriptions enumerate shape/operations; parsing one does not create backend aggregation, permissions, domain semantics or pagination correctness.

sources.title: Standard Schema
sources.designImplication: Validation interoperability and JSON Schema conversion are distinct contracts; inspectable metadata must actually exist.

sources.title: Structured Outputs
sources.designImplication: Schema conformity does not eliminate mistakes. Validate semantic meaning and task outcomes beyond parser success.

sources.title: MCP architecture 2026-07-28
sources.designImplication: Protocol context/tool exchange is distinct from model reasoning. Negotiate supported protocol versions; no mandatory nested model invocation for external-agent calls.

sources.title: Chrome WebMCP imperative API
sources.designImplication: The fetched documentation uses document.modelContext.registerTool with abort-aware lifecycle. Experimental native support must be tested, not inferred from a simulated host.

sources.title: Lit SSR overview
sources.designImplication: Lit SSR is experimental Labs functionality. Early production consumer proof is mandatory; missing SSR/browser validation is not a pass.

sources.title: Lit React integration
sources.designImplication: Thin property/event wrappers can reuse custom elements; actual controlled values, SSR, refs and cleanup remain Aeliqo tests.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Reflow understanding
sources.designImplication: Essential two-dimensional content has a bounded reflow exception. Do not hide comparison relationships merely to avoid horizontal scroll.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG patterns
sources.designImplication: Reference keyboard/focus/semantic control patterns. Automated tests do not replace real assistive-technology review.

sources.title: Web Vitals
sources.designImplication: Whole-page field metrics and percentile thresholds differ from library planner benchmarks. Measure both honestly.

sources.title: Optimize long tasks
sources.designImplication: Break/yield expensive work; avoid blocking interaction. Worker or scheduler abstraction must be justified by measured workloads.

sources.title: Playwright visual snapshots
sources.designImplication: Screenshot baselines vary by OS/browser/fonts and environment; pin/reference each environment and review meaningful diffs.

sources.title: DTCG format 2025.10
sources.designImplication: Token interchange is a community specification; using it is not claiming Aeliqo is a W3C industry standard.

sources.title: PostgreSQL transaction isolation
sources.designImplication: Snapshot consistency depends on transaction/isolation semantics; multiple reads cannot claim a global snapshot by default.

sources.title: PostgreSQL row security
sources.designImplication: Host-enforced row policy is distinct from client UI filtering. Aeliqo discovery and execution must honor actual application authority.

sources.title: OWASP LLM prompt injection prevention
sources.designImplication: Treat source text as untrusted data, enforce capability/egress bounds and review side effects; a system prompt alone is not access control.

sources.title: npm unpublish policy
sources.designImplication: Published name/version pairs cannot be overwritten or reused after unpublishing. Release new unused versions and migrate explicitly.

sources.title: npm trusted publishing
sources.designImplication: OIDC-based publication requires supported account/CI configuration. Do not invent current project credentials or publisher setup.

sources.title: OpenAI subagents
sources.designImplication: Subagents can have model/effort and role controls. Verify actual local Astra Medium/Luna Max availability and effective settings.

sources.title: OpenAI configuration reference
sources.designImplication: Fetched config documents agents.default_subagent_model, default_subagent_reasoning_effort and max_concurrent_threads_per_session. Client-specific support still must be verified.

sources.title: OpenAI harness engineering
sources.designImplication: Use repository documentation, concise entry instructions, mechanical boundaries and observable tests; avoid giant repeated context dumps.

limitations: npm registry access from execution container failed EAI_AGAIN; no new dependency lockfile or installed renderer proof.
No provider secrets, model execution, native WebMCP or remote mutations were used in this kit validation.
